titles.title: East River with Sun

description: The East River runs through the center of this composition between two banks filled with large buildings. Fog permeates the cityscape, and smokestacks emit clouds into the sky. The sun cuts through the fog, illuminating the river in shades of white and silver.
title: East River with Sun
